name.value: Arrowhead Campground, Green Lake Provincial Park

description.value: A developed lakeshore campground on 14 km Green Lake in BC's Cariboo, with warm shallow sand-and-pebble beaches and rainbow trout fishing; reached via gravel roads from Hwy 97 or Hwy 24, with the gate closed in winter.

address.value: Greenlake N, 70 Mile House, BC V0K 2K1, Canada

raw_osm.name: Arrowhead Campground, Green Lake Provincial Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Green Lake Park is active, with Arrowhead listed as one of five developed campground sites intended for high levels of recreation. The website prominently features a 'Book camping' link and describes the BC Parks frontcountry reservation system, supporting a true value for reservations accepted. Most specific amenity details (showers, potable water, food storage, etc.) are not broken out for Arrowhead specifically on the park page, so those fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: OSM email (parkinquiries@telus.net) is an operator-level contact for Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd. and does not appear on the BC Parks website, which lists parkinfo@gov.bc.ca as the official contact; the OSM email cannot be verified from the website.
The BC Parks page covers the entire Green Lake Park complex (11 sites) without breaking out amenity details specific to Arrowhead Campground, leaving most optional amenity fields unverifiable.
Nearest communities (70 Mile House, Lone Butte, 100 Mile House) are 16–18 km away; food and resupply access is limited and not walkable from the campground.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Arrowhead is an active, developed BC Provincial Park campground with online reservations — a viable overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through the Cariboo corridor between 70 Mile House and Lone Butte.
